seoTitle: Upload an Image to Squarespace, Any Size Picture
metaDescription: Add images to your Squarespace asset library and use them anywhere on your site, from blog posts to product pages.
intro: Uploading images is one of the most common tasks on a Squarespace site, whether you're adding photos to a blog post or building a business page. This guide covers getting an image into your asset library and ready to use anywhere on your site.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Sign in to your account, using Continue with Google if that's linked, then choose the site you want to work on from the dashboard.

steps.heading: Open the Assets section
steps.body: Navigate to your site's Assets area, usually found under Settings or the Library menu depending on your template version.

steps.heading: Upload your image
steps.body: Click the Upload button, browse your computer for the file, and select Open to start the upload.

steps.heading: Wait for the upload to finish
steps.body: Depending on your internet connection, the image typically uploads within a few seconds.

steps.heading: Use the image on your site
steps.body: Once uploaded, the image is available in your asset library to place on any page or post that needs it.

faq.question: Where do uploaded images end up in Squarespace?
faq.answer: They're stored in your Assets library, from which you can use them on any page, post, or gallery site-wide.

faq.question: Is there a size limit for images I upload?
faq.answer: Squarespace can handle a wide range of image sizes, though very large files may take longer to upload and load for visitors.

faq.question: Can I reuse the same image on multiple pages?
faq.answer: Yes, once an image is in your asset library you can insert it on as many pages or posts as you need.

faq.question: Where is the Assets section located?
faq.answer: It typically sits under Settings or the Library area, though the exact location can vary slightly by template.
